items.label: Skull
items.fact: The skull PROTECTS the brain — a built-in helmet!

items.label: Jawbone
items.fact: T-rex jaws could crunch with the force of three cars stacked up!

items.label: Tooth row
items.fact: Dinosaur teeth grew back all through their lives. Lucky them!

items.label: Backbone
items.fact: The backbone SUPPORTS the whole body — animals with one are vertebrates.

items.label: Ribs
items.fact: Ribs make a cage that protects the heart and lungs.

items.label: Tail bones
items.fact: Max's tail is a chain of bones — great for balance AND tail spins.

items.label: Thigh bone
items.fact: The thigh bone is the biggest bone — it helps you MOVE!

items.label: Shin bone
items.fact: Muscles pull on leg bones in pairs to walk, run and STOMP.

items.label: Toe bones
items.fact: T-rex walked on its toes — sneaky-quick for something so huge!
